title: 3 Dividend Kings to Buy in November That Could Pay You for the Rest of Your Life
author: Micah Zimmerman
description: The article highlights three Dividend King companies (those that have raised dividends for 50+ consecutive years) as attractive November buys: Walmart is using $2.9 billion in tariff refunds for price cuts and AI shopping tools; Lowe's is leveraging contractor sales and a new Bilt rewards partnership to offset DIY spending weakness; and Genuine Parts (NAPA) is preparing for a 2027 split into two independent companies while maintaining its 70-year dividend streak.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Company is returning tariff refunds to customers through 11,000+ price rollbacks, expanding AI shopping assistant usage (up 70% YoY with 40% higher spending), and maintaining 53-year dividend growth streak. Strong positioning in consumer staples with strategic holiday promotions targeting budget-conscious consumers.

Despite DIY spending weakness, company achieved fifth consecutive quarter of growth through contractor focus, online orders, and installation services. New initiatives include AI shopping assistant (25M+ questions), exclusive Bilt rewards partnership with 8M members, and expanded product lines. Maintains 50+ year dividend growth streak.

Company maintains impressive 70-year dividend growth streak and is executing planned 2027 split into two independent companies. However, facing near-term headwinds from higher energy prices weakening consumer sentiment, with comparable retail sales down 3% last quarter and trimmed profit forecast. Long-term dividend commitment remains strong.

title: Home Depot's Best Comp of the Year Arrives With a Thinner Margin
author: Na
description: Home Depot exceeded Q3 revenue expectations with $43.4B in sales (up 4.9%) and 2.2% comparable sales growth, but margins contracted significantly. Gross margin fell to 32.8% from 33.4% year-over-year, with the company guiding sales to the high end while margins move to the low end of guidance. The margin pressure stems from acquisition-driven growth through lower-margin professional distribution channels. Management also implied fourth-quarter comparable sales will decelerate to around 1% despite strong current momentum.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: While the company beat revenue expectations and showed resilience in a weak housing market, profitability metrics deteriorated significantly. Gross and operating margins contracted despite strong sales growth, indicating the company is 'buying growth rather than earning it' through acquisitions. Management guided margins to the low end of ranges while implying Q4 deceleration, suggesting limited near-term upside.

The article anticipates Lowe's will report similar negative trends as Home Depot, with revenue growth driven by acquisitions while earnings decline. The home improvement sector's signature pattern of revenue growth on acquisitions coupled with earnings shrinkage is expected to be confirmed by Lowe's earnings report.

title: Why Investors Need to Take Advantage of These 2 Retail and Wholesale Stocks Now
author: Zacks.Com
description: The article highlights two retail stocks with positive Earnings Surprise Prediction (ESP) metrics ahead of their earnings reports: Macy's (reporting December 2, 2026) with an +18.84% ESP and Lowe's (reporting November 18, 2026) with a +0.59% ESP. Both stocks carry a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating, and their positive ESP figures suggest potential for earnings surprises.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Strong positive Earnings ESP of +18.84% indicates analyst estimate revisions suggest potential for positive earnings surprise. Most Accurate Estimate (-$0.14) is better than Consensus Estimate (-$0.17).

Positive Earnings ESP of +0.59% suggests potential for earnings surprise. Most Accurate Estimate ($2.88) exceeds Consensus Estimate ($2.86), indicating analyst confidence ahead of imminent earnings report.

title: Breakfast News: All Ears On Nvidia Today
author: Tmf Breakfast News
description: Nvidia reports Q3 fiscal 2027 earnings today under new interim CEO Colette Kress following Jensen Huang's departure after 33 years. Key focus areas include whether the company can maintain 70% revenue growth projections, pricing power, the Vera Rubin platform's contribution, and transparency on chip distribution amid Singapore scrutiny. Retail earnings from Target, Lowe's, and TJX Companies will set the holiday shopping tone. CrowdStrike continues to show strong growth with AI-powered cybersecurity solutions.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: While the business fundamentals remain excellent, the stock faces three open questions: leadership transition, revenue reporting transparency, and ongoing investigations. Recent 4.1% decline reflects uncertainty despite strong growth projections.
Recent quarter showed strong 3.8% traffic-led comparable sales growth and double-digit gains in key categories. Expected to demonstrate holiday season strength as a Rule Breakers recommendation.
Expected seasonal earnings decline of 35% EPS on 14% lower revenue is typical post-summer. Performance depends on housing-driven DIY demand and recent acquisition integration benefits.
Hidden Gems recommendation expected to show raised guidance and progress on store growth plans. Watch for tariff refund benefits and holiday trends in HomeGoods and Marmaxx divisions.

Strong fundamentals with 26% YoY revenue growth, record ARR and cash flow. Named Gartner Leader for seventh consecutive year. AI-powered threat intelligence platform positions it well for continued growth amid rising cyber threats.
Used as example of successful long-term investing, trading around $283 versus $111.93 recommendation price in March 2022, demonstrating value of patience through market volatility.

title: Home Depot Accelerates Express Delivery: Can It Fuel Growth?
author: Na
description: Home Depot has rolled out nationwide express delivery offering eligible products within three hours, with most deliveries completed in under an hour. Digital platform sales grew 11% in Q2'26, marking five consecutive quarters of double-digit growth. Competitors Lowe's and Floor & Décor are also enhancing delivery capabilities. However, housing affordability pressures and weak remodeling demand pose growth risks.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Strong execution on delivery expansion with 11% digital platform sales growth for five consecutive quarters. Express delivery nationwide and improved logistics capabilities support customer loyalty and market share gains, though offset somewhat by housing affordability headwinds.

Actively enhancing delivery capabilities with next-day appliance delivery across virtually all U.S. ZIP codes and planned Foundation Building Materials acquisition to accelerate fulfillment and attract professional contractors.

Strengthening supply-chain capabilities through reduced distribution-center-to-store lead times, deeper inventories, and expanded warehouse footprint to serve professional contractors and improve market position.
